cancelCampaign().notice: Creator can cancel the campaign before deadline (if goal not reached).         Backers may then claim refunds.

claimRefund().notice: Backers claim refund if goal not met after deadline,         or if the campaign is cancelled.

finalizePayout(uint256).notice: Anyone can trigger payout release if votes_for already exceeds quorum.         Useful for finalizing without a new vote tx.

postUpdate(string).notice: Creator posts an update (stores IPFS CID on-chain).

requestPayout(uint256).notice: Creator requests payout for a specific milestone.         Backers then vote to approve or reject.

vote(uint256,bool).notice: Backers vote to approve or reject a milestone payout.

userdoc.notice: Trustless crowdfunding contract with milestone-based escrow,         backer voting, and automatic refunds.

params._metadataCid: IPFS CID pointing to JSON with title/desc/image.
params._milestonePercs: Array of milestone fund percentages (must sum to 100).

returns.campaignAddress: Address of newly deployed Campaign contract.
